name: Connors/Alvarez ETF 3-day reversion (three lower highs and lows)
author: Pine port of Larry Connors / Cesar Alvarez High Probability ETF Trading 3-day mean reversion
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: close < EMA(5) AND three consecutive lower highs and lower lows (high<high[1]<high[2]<high[3] and low<low[1]<low[2]<low[3]); optional qualifier: close > EMA(200).
exit: Close long when close crosses above EMA(5).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
implementation_notes: Source description says it modifies the book rules (book version uses SMA(5) exit and 200 SMA filter); the Pine file is the authoritative spec here.
